name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.4.7
summary: Registration password hardening: SecretBox AES-256-GCM envelope encryption, auto-purge with clock guard, and request takeover prevention
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.4.7:
* **SecretBox Envelope Encryption:** Passwords in self-registrations are encrypted with AES-256-GCM (v1:<key_id>:<b64(nonce+ct)>) using per-installation 256-bit random keys in CONFIG_DIR/registration_keys/ (0600 mode) with AAD binding reg:{id}:{username}.
* **Secure Zeroization & Storage:** Passwords are zeroized immediately upon approval, rejection, lock, or expiration, and SQLite PRAGMA secure_delete=ON is enforced across all registration database connections.
* **Request Takeover Prevention:** Disallows submitting duplicate pending requests or replacing an existing request with a mismatched mobile number (HTTP 409 Conflict).
* **Configurable Expiry & Approval Purge:** Added configurable OTP expiration (otp_expiry_minutes, 1-30 min) and approval TTL (registration_approval_ttl_days, 1-90 days) with an automated purge service.
* **Clock Guard Protection:** Safety brake trips if a sudden time jump would expire >20% or >10 pending requests, requiring explicit administrator review or force purge.
* **Encrypted Backups:** Backup archives include registration keys and support password-derived encryption (Scrypt + AES-256-GCM) with warning banners when keys are missing.
